description: Revokes a pending invitation so its link stops working immediately. Owners and admins (admins only for member or viewer invitations). Call without confirm first for a preview, then again with confirm and the preview_token.

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

name: company_invite_revoke
title: Revoke an invitation
